Package com.leap.leaplaughlove.iam.client

Record Class PendingRegistration

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.leap.leaplaughlove.iam.client.PendingRegistration
Record Components:
registrationId - the unique identifier of the application
tokenHash - the SHA-256 of the token in the emailed link; the token itself is never stored
email - the applicant's email address
phone - the applicant's normalized phone number, or null if none was given
fullName - the applicant's full name
dateOfBirth - the applicant's date of birth
ssn - the applicant's Social Security Number
addressLine1 - primary address line
addressLine2 - secondary address line (optional)
city - address city
stateRegion - address state or region
postalCode - address postal code
countryCode - two-letter ISO country code
experienceLevel - investment experience level
initialDepositAmount - the amount to deposit into the client's first account
passwordHash - the hash of the password the applicant chose
createdAt - when the application was submitted
expiresAt - when the emailed link stops working
public record PendingRegistration(UUID registrationId, String tokenHash, String email, String phone, String fullName, LocalDate dateOfBirth, String ssn, String addressLine1, String addressLine2, String city, String stateRegion, String postalCode, String countryCode, String experienceLevel, BigDecimal initialDepositAmount, String passwordHash, Instant createdAt, Instant expiresAt) extends Record
An application waiting for the applicant to open the link they were emailed. It becomes a client only then, so an application nobody confirms never holds an email, phone number or SSN.
